title: Window 8a (Agent 8, run-2 task #7 follow-up): #2 shader miss cache on native4b (S4b + S4c native, every switch OFF). n0 (miss cache OFF) vs mc (LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE=1), native frames, 6 round-robin rounds
notes: Follow-up window proposed by Agent 8 (run-2 task #7) on 2026-11-22 for the 01:00-06:45 slot; Agent 1 picks. Staged and checked with build/agent8/w-followup/stage-window.ps1. GO: 'GO W8a matrix-window8a.json <sha256> only=n0,mc repeats=6': one unscored cold run (native4b), then 6 round-robin rounds with the start arm alternating: 1 + 12 = 13 runs.

W8a (S4-DRAFT L373: native S4a with #2 ON; Agent 1, 21:15: on native4b after the re-pin). Both arms use one bin, so the pair isolates #2 (rexlego gpu_native/shaders.cpp; env var, unset = OFF). Metric: render-thread ms/f and fps on native (native-frames.csv), plus p99, the 1 % low and process CPU. S4-DRAFT row 2's estimate: about 2-2.5 ms/f of render thread in the foreground, up to ~6 ms/f in the slow state.

Gates before the GO: native4b-bin staged with Agent 4's pin record (fingerprint 9b40acbbef4c57b3); the re-pin rows rpb0 and rpm4 PASS (build/agent4/repin/REPIN.md 3a and 3b); s4b02 (native4b OFF, menus) PASS; and #2 ON on native4b: either an r6-style traced ON/OFF pair (shader_miss_cache_insert rows for VS AC449538 and PS AC448F28 in events.tsv, logdiff NEW 0 / MORE 0) or Agent 1 accepts Agent 3's r6 on native4 (PASS, Agent 4's verdict) as its cover.

No trace in a timed arm: a trace turns off buffer/texture reuse and some draw fast paths (Agent 4). Without the trace #2 ON adds no game.log line, so mc's ON proof is LEGO_NATIVE_SHADER_MISS_CACHE=1 in run.json env_set, which n0 must not have. Both arms set LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS=<run>\native-frames.csv (the native frame source; the runner expands <run> per run). cvars as the n-rows (build/agent4/repin/matrix-repin-native4b.json): native_settings_frontend=false, native_fps_limit=0, framerate_limit=0.

Window: 5 s settle + 55 s warm-up from the first frame, then 50 s measured, so every window starts >= 60 s after the first frame (min_window_after_ff_s 60, Agent 1's floor); the runner flags window_before_floor (excluded) below 59.5 s. The cold run: 55 s warm-up, 30 s window. One frame source for every arm: native-frames.csv (frames native), uncapped; the same driver (drivers/thread-cpu.ps1 -> threads.csv).

sys_csv: drivers/sys-csv.ps1 logs the system state every 1 s (sys.csv, sys.json). Input during the window, the game losing the foreground, battery, battery saver, a power-plan change, a non-default input desktop or a screensaver exclude a run from summary.md (it stays in results.csv, under 'Flagged runs').

Environment: after the 08:29 Windows Update; native numbers compare only with native runs under the same host state. Timing comes only from the user's unlocked desktop (Agent 5's overnight launcher); agent runs of this matrix (-Quick, hidden desktop) are functional only.
